sañcalana.p: [ saṃ+ cala+ yu,] (na) CL=7 [Nīti, dhātu. 167, 210.saṃcalana-saṃ.saṃcalaṇa-pākata.] It moves (or) It trembles. See original.

R:

ထိုမှဤမှလှုပ်သည်။

R:
sañcarati：သဉ္စရတိ （သံ√စရ်）

(A) It makes effort, The state of affairs of making effort. (B) The dhamma that can make an effort. (2) A goodwill that is obvious.  (Ti) (3) The obvious goodwill. (2) (Ti) (3) See - Sañcetanika (1) (A) (B).

R:

sañcālesi.p: [ saṃ + cala + ṇe + ī ] (kā, kri) CL=7 See - Sañcāleti.
